ORDER by Magistrate Judge Lisa J. Cisneros: Having reviewed Plaintiffs' unilateral discovery letter 643 and Stability's Response 681 Plaintiffs' request that the Court "order Plaintiffs and Stability to finalize all meet-and-confers over the pending discovery disputes identified" in Plaintiffs' unilateral discovery brief "by a date certain and file any briefing on a date certain shortly thereafter" is DENIED. The Court agrees with Stability that Plaintiffs are effectively requesting an extension to the case schedule and have not demonstrated the requisite diligence in seeking this extension.
